title.en: The Crown, the flags and the legislature buildings
title.fr: La Couronne, les drapeaux et les édifices des assemblées législatives

text.en: The Crown stands for the state. It has done so in Canada for 400 years.
text.fr: La Couronne représente l'État. Elle le fait au Canada depuis 400 ans.

source.quote: The Crown has been a symbol of the state in Canada for 400 years.

text.en: The provinces and the territories have their own flags too. Each flag stands for the traditions that set that place apart.
text.fr: Les provinces et les territoires ont eux aussi leur propre drapeau. Chaque drapeau représente les traditions qui distinguent cet endroit.

source.quote: The provinces and territories also have flags that embody their distinct traditions.

text.en: The fleur-de-lys came back into use at Confederation. It was one of the symbols on the Canadian Red Ensign.
text.fr: La fleur-de-lys est revenue en usage au moment de la Confédération. Elle figurait parmi les symboles du Red Ensign canadien.

source.quote: Revived at Confederation, the fleur-de-lys was included in the Canadian Red Ensign.

text.en: The Parliament Buildings bring three traditions together: those of Aboriginal peoples, of the English and of the French. Their arches, towers, sculptures and stained glass also show the Gothic Revival style, popular in Queen Victoria's time.
text.fr: Les édifices du Parlement réunissent trois traditions : celles des Autochtones, des Anglais et des Français. Leurs arcs, leurs tours, leurs sculptures et leurs vitraux montrent aussi le style néogothique, populaire à l'époque de la reine Victoria.

source.quote: The towers, arches, sculptures and stained glass of the Parliament Buildings embody the French, English and Aboriginal traditions and the Gothic Revival architecture popular in the time of Queen Victoria.

text.en: Each province's legislature building is a treasure of architecture. Quebec's National Assembly was built in the style known as French Second Empire.
text.fr: Les édifices des assemblées législatives des provinces sont des trésors d'architecture. L'Assemblée nationale du Québec a été construite dans le style Second Empire français.

source.quote: The provincial legislatures are architectural treasures. The Quebec National Assembly is built in the French Second Empire style

text.en: In the other provinces, the legislature buildings are Baroque, Romanesque or neoclassical. Those styles come from the Greek and Roman heritage of Western civilization, where democracy began.
text.fr: Dans les autres provinces, les édifices législatifs sont de style baroque, roman ou néoclassique. Ces styles viennent de l'héritage gréco-romain de la civilisation occidentale, là où la démocratie est née.

source.quote: the legislatures of the other provinces are Baroque, Romanesque and neoclassical, reflecting the Greco-Roman heritage of Western civilization in which democracy originated.
